name: Unconstrained Isosurface Extraction on Arbitrary Octrees
definition: A novel algorithm for generating a watertight level-set from an octree where both the octree structure and vertex values are unconstrained, without requiring node refinement or value modification.
summary: This primal method extracts watertight isosurfaces from arbitrary octrees without refinement by using binary edge-trees to resolve inconsistencies at face boundaries between nodes of different depths.
